extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors attempting to create or locate a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for locating, creating, or troubleshooting a new Wikipedia page (here: 'SNL jokes 2025'), including account requirements, search/redirect checks, visibility delays, and deletion-log checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not autoconfirmed, alternatives include using the article wizard to submit a draft for review or requesting a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'SNL jokes 2025' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title; checking linked pages can reveal alternative names or where content already exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for recent-creation visibility delay and use purge if needed
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh the database view and see recently created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization rules and use of redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title if capitalization differences cause the page not to appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: If a page was deleted, consult the deletion log and explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log entries to learn the reason for deletion and any guidance on how to address issues before attempting to recreate or recover the page.
